name: Sonae Industria, S.G.P.S., S.A.
summary: Sonae Indústria, SGPS, S.A. produces and sells wood-based panels for construction, furniture, and decoration industries. The company offers particleboards, MDF, melamine-faced products, high pressure laminates, and other related products. Sonae Indústria is headquartered in Maia, Portugal.
